    Format, coverage, and review notes

    10 original scenarios · 62 scored tasks · all five Core 1 domains · reviewed September 21, 2026. Networking receives extra practice for servers and IP addressing. This is focused practice, not complete coverage of every objective or a full mock exam.

    CompTIA describes A+ PBQs as simulations and publishes a demonstration. These exercises use equipment images, placement targets, device hotspots, configuration panels, tabs, and Reset All controls modeled on the interaction methods in the supplied sample simulations. They are not copied live exam items, not endorsed by CompTIA, and not a replica of every exam interface.

    Practice scoring: one point per correct task; blanks earn zero. Actual CompTIA item weighting and scaled scores are not reproduced here. A practice percentage cannot be converted to an A+ passing score.

    Offline results last only while this page stays open. Download the CSV before closing. Unsubmitted selections stay only while this page remains open. Reset clears this scenario’s current selections and shuffles choices; saved scores remain. Submitted results remain locked until you reset.
